versions.changelog:
Initial release — scrape TikTok posts by location using Apify's TikTok Location Scraper.

- Triggers when asked to fetch TikTok posts from a geotagged place or location URL.
- Returns post title, stats (views, likes, comments, shares), channel info, hashtags, timestamp, video URL, and more.
- Supports input of TikTok location/place URLs; optional limits and transformations.
- Handles empty results, private videos, and deleted locations gracefully.
- Ideal for local marketing, events, and geo-targeted research.
